[b]August 28, 2026: The Imperial Defense Force[/b]

Baron Sigismund Von Lenstahl was a powerful man, some said even more powerful than the government of Thýven itself, though he denied the entire idea as preposterous. He was the governour of the Bank of Tharkønn, an institution which, following the July 4th declaration had seen itself become a jewel in imperial foreign and domestic affairs, the bank held the largest amount of collateral for the government, property, and was a major funding arm for the various paramilitaries and armies of the princes of the empire. It was even suspected that the bank funded the National Defense Forces themselves, though these claims were generally unfounded to the public eye. 

However, there was no doubt that the Baron Lenstahl held massive sway in the private affairs of the government, indeed his hands were deep into the coffers of the major houses of Thýven, though he never touched the church, which had its own banking structure by law, separation of church and state or something of the sort.

Now as he sat in his offices in Tharkønn, a cup of tea before him, his mind flitted to the revolutions occurring world-wide, communism was rapidly becoming a lucrative business to fund due to the high success rate of the revolutions. He also had noted the opportunistic means by which the government of Thýven had begun to present itself, quietly supporting the governments of those nations, thereby both legitimising and de-legitimising the states, for if a communist state privately relied on funds and loans from Thýven, then the revolution was for naught. 

But he knew Thýven was also a sitting duck, for while it had massive power, that power had little chance of being fully used for fear of upsetting its allies in THEP. This matter was an itch in the government of Thývens mind, nagging, and unsettling, it was something that had to be solved immediately.

This was where he came in, Lenstahl, with all his money and all his influence, had quietly moved some of his own money from his own accounts towards the funding of a government sanctioned elite paramilitary force to be placed under the direct authority of the head of state, not a royal guard, but a shadow-guard of sorts, acting as a levy that the monarch could use directlyor at this point, the Patriarchate. The name of this shadow-guard? The Imperial Defense Force (IDF) on paper, but in vernacular it was known among the government as The Saints of the Empire Imperial Forces (TSEIF). 

The forces were comprised of three branches, aerial, naval, and ground divisions, though not as robust as the National Defense Forces, the paramilitary was well-equipped for more delicate operations than a full brigade, and had no fear of funding running low, for Lenstahl was the primary funding officer. 

As of right now active recruitment and training was ongoing, however, he had promised to assemble the first regiment by the beginning of October, drawing from the most hardened places of the armed forces and from Thývens convicts. Lenstahl envisioned that this force would be even more powerful in power-projection than say that of the National Defense Forces.

Estimates suggest over [b]600,000 civillians[/b] were killed and [b]895,000 wounded or injured[/b]. So far, the [b]fighting remains in Vald, Therene [/b] and even in wilderness. Analysts predict the siege will determine whether ISV can transition into a bigger problem for Valddera or be defeated. With [b]70,000 estimated fighters of ISV[/b] and more military traitor volunteers against Valddera's red army. Although the organization is targeting Valddera's weak spots like economical buildings and political government towers, along with [b] civilian deaths and hostages.[/b]

The [b]ISV [/b]have currently taken some really important cities in just a few days, already[b] destorying major Valdderan army[/b] and [i]weakening[/i] the state. [quote=thep;60621167][b]THEP intervenes[/b]
The rapid escalation of events in Vespurias would soon catch the attention of the THEP security council. One of the alliances own members had fallen to dark magic not seen on a scale this size for centuries. As such, the alliance knew that the response had to be of equal size to combat the growing threat. With intel from Vespurias delegations, the Security Councils military command would form a hasty strategy to counter this international crisis.

The first thing on the agenda would be to prevent the spread of magic, and the horrific creatures that became of it, outside of Vespurias. THEP would seek to establish a total naval blockade of Vespurias, firing upon ghastly beings that lurked below, or war criminals fleeing from the scene. However, THEP also knew that aid needed to get in and civilians needed to get out, so the fleets would form entrance points in the blockade, a sort of border crossing between the chaos of Vespurias and the outside world. These border crossings would be administered by THEP to allow international aid, relief and mercenaries in, whilst catching loose criminals and stopping the spread of magic.

The THEP military command would issue notices and orders to the nations of the security council, asking for their help in the immense operation, as they knew that a feat of this size would require the full force available to THEP.

Hydronia would deploy several naval fleets to the scene, despite the fact that their military would still be recovering from the THEP-EDU war. The following would be sent to the area:
[list]
1x aircraft carrier (+helicopters and jets to survey the situation from above)
75x patrol boats
4x destroyers
15x corvettes
2x minelayers
1x amphibious landing craft
3x submarines
[/list]
Hydronia knew that sending this many ships into battle would be a risky move, but the risk would be worth it to save the people of Vespurias from this living nightmare.

The event in Vespurias has also the Bobian Royal Navy to mobilise. It has been preparing for the past few months, in conjunction with the THEP military command to bombard the shores of Vespuria with artillery and guns to destroy as many demons and creatures living there, but first we have to evacuate and clear out the cities of people to safe areas. So initially 10 ships will be sent out to Vespuria to land on the beaches and deploy 20 PT-3's also known as The Pyramid Type 3 per ship. The first ship will land and deploy all 20 vehicles onto the coast, all of which will drive forwards and make a circle to protect the area where the next 10 ships will land and release there vehicles all of which will fall in behind the ones at the front once all the ships have gone the vehicles will move forwards creating a much larger ring of "Pyramids". This will then become Bobian Deployment 1. This will be repeated a further 2 times along the coast to form a protected military base. This will then be filled with soldiers, buildings and more conventional Military vehicles such as Tanks and Armoured Vehicles.

Whilst these measures from the Hydronians and the Bobians would allow for containment of the mainland, a battle had already begun in the Baliwick sea. The assembled THEP blockade fleet would delegate a handful of reconnaissance ships, escorted by missile-carrying corvettes, to observe the unfolding battle and report back to the THEP military command so that a further plan can be formulated and executed.

Meanwhile, on the diplomatic side of things, THEP has called upon its partner members to assist the humanitarian and peacekeeping efforts of the operation. THEP will need all the assistance it can get to prevent the fall of Vespurias and its people.
